name: Tony Benn
full_name: Labour MP and minister, leader of the Labour left

snapshots.label: Labour left
snapshots.basis: Starts from the Labour profile (Michael Foot era), adjusted where Tony Benn's own stated views differ. Views only, not actions.

notes.ECO: Wanted public ownership and workers' control of industry.
notes.SOC: Further to the progressive side than Labour's mainstream of the time.
notes.LIB: Defended civil liberties and the right to protest.
notes.MIG: In line with the Labour profile (Michael Foot era).
notes.INT: Campaigned to leave the European Community in 1975 and after.
notes.CLI: In line with the Labour profile (Michael Foot era).
notes.TEC: In line with the Labour profile (Michael Foot era).
notes.DEM: Distrusted unaccountable power, from the Lords to Brussels and the City.
